pages.title: Resonant Tuning Fork
pages.text: A tuning fork whose tines are entangled: struck once, it keeps ringing. It calibrates like the plain fork but never wears out, and when an answer is wrong it says how far off it is (how many primes are missed, which step of a proof fails, how many elements are out of balance). Made by crafting.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Quantum Entanglement.
